item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":[{"citation":"“Blind-run all three cases again… using one fresh, context-free agent per case”; “After every run, check the live checkout with `git status` and clean any leaked changes”; and “Repeat important or borderline cases 2–3 times to account for nondeterminism and report pass rates.”","criterion":"C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.","status":"necessary"}],"rationale":"The reruns validate the revision and guard against regressions, while fresh agents, checkout cleanup, separate judges, and limited repetition protect isolation, integrity, and reproducibility.
